import sys, time, json, subprocess; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from wire import v

PAIRS=2000
def initial(pn,payload):
    return bytes([0xc1])+b'\0\0\0\1'+b'\x01\xaa'+b'\x01\xbb'+v(0)+v(2+len(payload))+pn.to_bytes(2,'big')+payload
def ack(largest,first,pairs):
    return b'\x03'+v(largest,width=8)+v(0)+v(len(pairs))+v(first)+b''.join(v(g)+v(r) for g,r in pairs)+v(0)+v(0)+v(0)

envs=[]; pn=0; largest=10**7
for i in range(2100):
    pairs=[]
    low=largest
    ok=True
    for k in range(PAIRS):
        high=low-2-2
        if high<1: ok=False; break
        pairs.append((2,1)); low=high-1
    if not ok: break
    fr=ack(largest,0,pairs)
    envs.append(initial(pn,fr))
    pn+=1
    largest-= (PAIRS*5+10)
CH=200; events=[]
